title: WP-2026-0148: land the WP-2026-0147 reconcile so new work packages are unblocked
problem:
## Problem

WP-2026-0147 landed as 9b4f29d (#339), but its record on `main` still says `IN_PROGRESS`. `badf_gate.py repo` refuses any new work package until the landed one is reconciled. The reconcile already exists as commit 11617f3, written by `badf_gate.py reconcile WP-2026-0147`. It was parked on a session branch, and its carrier PR #340 was closed unmerged because a reconcile ships inside a work package.

## Requested outcome

A minimal work package that lands the reconcile and nothing else:

- `work/WP-2026-0147/work-package.json`: `status` CLOSED, `landed_as` 9b4f29d, `composition_verified` false. The value is false because the landed tree carries no G07 composition-record.json; the landed tree d947757 does match the pre-merge verified tree.
- `badf/lockfile.json` re-signed by the same command.
- No code, schema, doc or control changes.

Authorised by the operator in a Claude Code session on 2026-09-28.
note: ATTRIBUTED, not independently verifiable. The operator started WP-2026-0148 in a Claude Code session chat ('start WP-2026-0148 and carry the reconcile') and chose the reconcile-only scope when offered alternatives. #341 was opened by the agent under the shared bstBizEra account, so no structural actor field distinguishes the operator's authorisation from an agent's record of it (#261 / #308). The merge is the checkable human gate.
